THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON Xxxxxx vs State Of Kerala on 2 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85875023/
1 02.06.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 CRL.MC NO. 951 OF 2024 2  2025:KER:38358  ORDER

The petitioner is the accused in SC.No. 923/2022 on the files of the Fast Track Special Court-II,
Manjeri.
The allegation against him is that he committed rape of the defacto complainant by giving false promise of marriage.
It is also alleged that the petitioner criminally intimidated the defacto complainant by saying that her naked photos will be published in social media.

The final report in this case has been filed before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Malappuram, by the Inspector of Police, Women Cell, Malappuram, alleging the commission of offences under Section 376(2)(n) and 506(1) of IPC.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Malappuram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The case was thereafter committed to the Sessions Court, Manjeri, and made over to the Fast Track Special Court-II, Manjeri, for trial.
2. In the present petition, the petitioner would contend that there is no offence attracted in the facts and circumstances of the case.
It is further stated that the petitioner has married the defacto complainant on 15.01.2022 and a girl child has been born in their wedlock on 08.03.2023.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned counsel for the 2nd respondent and the learned Public Prosecutor representing the State of Kerala.
4. The learned counsel for the 2nd respondent submitted that the petitioner and the 2nd respondent are now leading a peaceful family life pursuant to their marriage conducted on 15.01.2022.
The copy of the marriage certificate has been produced by the petitioner.

The defacto complainant has filed an affidavit before this court stating that she happened to prefer the complaint upon a false notion, and that at present, she has been leading a peaceful family life with the petitioner and the child born in her wedlock with the petitioner.

5. The learned Public Prosecutor submitted that as per the instructions received from the Investigating Officer, the defacto complainant had given a statement to the Investigating Officer also upon the same terms as that of the affidavit filed by her before this Court.

6. Since it is revealed from the records that the petitioner has married the defacto complainant, the allegation 2025:KER:38358 that he had committed rape of the defacto complainant upon false promise of marriage, is prima facie baseless.
Needless to say that the offences alleged in this case are not brought out.
Therefore, the prayer in this petition to quash the proceedings against the petitioner, is fully justified.
Xxxxxx vs State Of Kerala on 2 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85875023/
2 In the result, the petition stands allowed.

The proceedings against the petitioner in SC.No.
923/2022 on the files of the Fast Track Special Court-II, Manjeri, are hereby quashed.

Sd/-
G. GIRISH, JUDGE mea Xxxxxx vs State Of Kerala on 2 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85875023/
